matrixTitle: Kshetra Mobile Application Financial Consumer Compatibility Matrix

summary.unitTestPassRate: 100% (34/34 Jest tests passing, 50/50 Verifier tests passing)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Non-nullable numbers, formatINR lacked null check throwing TypeError, computeWealthGrowth produced NaN on nulls, detectRedFlags falsely flagged zero liability anomaly on nulls.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated CandidateAffidavit fields to 'number | null'. Hardened formatINR to return 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined and '₹0' for 0. Added isAvailable: boolean to WealthGrowth and returned null growths when either totalAssets is null. Guarded detectRedFlags against null liabilities and null assets.
consumers.verificationMethod: Jest sprint14-16.test.ts & Node test suite (Test 46, Test 47, Test 48)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Financial types lacked nullability, local formatINR threw on nulls, red flag detector lacked null guards.
consumers.implementedFix: Converted totalAssets and totalLiabilities to 'number | null'. Hardened formatINR to return 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined. Guarded detectAllRedFlags against null liabilities.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Called formatINR without guarding against unhardened utility, crashed on null growth percent toFixed.
consumers.implementedFix: Guarded latestGrowth.percentGrowth != null before calling toFixed. Passes nullable totalAssets and totalLiabilities to hardened formatINR.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Used '|| 0' fallbacks coercing missing disclosures to zero wealth; growth computation threw on nulls.
consumers.implementedFix: Removed all '|| 0' fallbacks. Added explicit 'Assets not disclosed' banner when totalAssets === null. Displays 'Component breakdown not itemized in filing' when asset breakdown is null. Renders dashed 2px baseline for undisclosed timeline bars.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Computed netWorth using '|| 0' fallbacks, displaying false ₹0 net worth for undisclosed legislators.
consumers.implementedFix: Removed '|| 0' fallbacks. Computes netWorth = (hasBoth ? totalAssets - liabilities : null). Renders 'Not Disclosed' when netWorth is null. Guarded zero liability anomaly against null liabilities.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Forced 8px minimum bar height for null assets, visually fabricating positive wealth for undisclosed years.
consumers.implementedFix: Filtered non-null assets when computing maxAssets. Undisclosed records render a dashed 2px baseline bar with zero height. Guarded percentGrowth and annualizedGrowth against null.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Summed assets with '|| 0' and divided by total candidates including undisclosed records, artificially depressing average assets and distorting crorepati percentages.
consumers.implementedFix: Filtered disclosed candidates (a.totalAssets != null) for avgAssets denominator. Tracks assetsDisclosedCandidatesCount. getCrorepatiCount returns { total, disclosedCount, crorepatis, percent }.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Local formatINR helper lacked nullability handling.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated formatINR(val?: number | null) to return 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined, '₹0' for 0.
Updated TelanganaMLA interface to allow number | null on financial fields.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Strict non-nullable number on MP financials.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated MPProfile interface to allow number | null on totalAssets and totalLiabilities.
